articles.body: On October 7th I tried to publish @​7onic-ui/tokens@​0.3.7 and npm told me my own package didn't exist. npm error 404 Not Found - PUT https://registry.npmjs.org/@7onic-ui%2ftokens npm error 404 '@7onic-ui/tokens@0.3.7' is not in this registry. A 404. On a PUT. For a package I'd published more than a dozen times before, from the same workflow. The release itself was as ready as a release gets — smoke tests green across three environments, seventeen publish checks passed, changelogs finalized. The only thing left was the button. I pressed it four times that day, and npm rejected me four times, each time with a different error. By the end of the next day I had fixed publishing.

articles.body: 수십 년간 미국 달러(USD)는 세계 기축통화로서, 국제 무역의 지배적인 매개체이자 글로벌 금융의 주춧돌로 군림해왔다. 브레튼우즈 협정을 기반으로 페트로달러 시스템으로 공고해진 이 독보적인 헤게모니는 미국에 막대한 지정학적, 경제적 영향력을 안겨주었다. 하지만 지금 그 풍경이 바뀌고 있다. 고조되는 지정학적 긴장, 금융 제재의 무기화, 미국 국가 부채 증가, 그리고 다극화된 세계 질서의 부상이라는 복합적인 요인들이 맞물리면서 '탈달러화'와 달러의 세계적 지배력 약화 가능성에 대한 논의가 점차 활발해지는 분위기다. 각국 정부와 기관들은 단일 국가가 통제하는 통화에 대한 과도한 의존이 가져오는 위험을 완화하고자 대안을 적극적으로 모색하는 중이다. 이러한 거시 금융 환경의 변화 속에서 비트코인(BTC)은 흥미롭고 점차 중요성이 커지는 플레이어로 부상하고 있다. 2008년 글로벌 금융 위기에서 탄생한 비트코인은 어떤 국가나 중앙은행에도 종속되지 않는, 탈중앙화되고 불변하며 허가 없는 디지털 자산으로 명확하게 설계되었다. 그 고유한 특성 덕분에 비트코인은 통화 가치 하락에 대한 잠재적 헤지 수단이자, 전통적인 금융 시스템 외부에서 가치를 이전할 수 있는 중립적이고 검열 저항적인 매개체가 될 수 있다. 세계 경제가 이러한 복잡한 전환기를 헤쳐나가는 지금, 비트코인의 잠재적 역할, 즉 달러의 대체재가 아닌 보완적 또는 대안적 주권 자산으로서의 역할을 이해하는 것은 정책 입안자, 경제학자, 투자자 모두에게 무엇보다 중요한 과제가 되었다.

articles.title: Claude Sonnet 5.5 cache reads cost half: measure your own savings
articles.excerpt: Anthropic cut the Claude Sonnet 5.5 prompt-cache read rate on October 7, 2026, from $0.20 to $0.10 per million tokens. The change halves the price of a cache read, but it does not halve an application…
articles.body: Anthropic cut the Claude Sonnet 5.5 prompt-cache read rate on October 7, 2026, from $0.20 to $0.10 per million tokens. The change halves the price of a cache read, but it does not halve an application’s model bill. Your impact depends on how many cache-read tokens your traffic actually generates, how much new caching writes cost, and how often requests miss. Start with the usage counters your application already receives. Compare the same workload before and after the rate change, and keep the calculation separate from output tokens, uncached input, retries, and any other price changes. That gives you a defensible read-cost delta without turning a vendor price cut into an unmeasured savings claim.
articles.author: Dave Kurian

And not just the return of the Horned One, but also his old teammates The Defenders. "I think there needed to be a full circle with that story," Cox told IGN's Jeffrey Vega today after the panel. "There needed to be some kind of closure with it." The Defenders of course originated in the Netflix Marvel era, where each character — Daredevil, Jessica Jones (Krysten Ritter), Luke Cage (Mike Colter), and Iron Fist (Finn Jones) — had their own series before teaming up for the 2017 Defenders season.

articles.title: 9 Legend of Zelda Side Quests Scarier than Any Horror Game
articles.excerpt: Cursed spider families, a ship that sails only at night, and a mummified father in a closet: nine Zelda side quests that belong in a horror story
articles.body: The Legend of Zelda has never been particularly shy about depicting curses, ghosts, and the walking dead (or ReDead). Its optional side quests are where Nintendo tends to let all three run wild. The series has always worked this way — usually giving you a bright, whimsical surface to explore with something rotten and/or horrifying tucked away, should you decide to look under that friendly surface. In the main story, that dread hides inside dungeons and boss fights. In the side quests, the dread has moved into the house next door, where it’s a bit more startling to discover. Curious what nightmares are hiding for Link throughout his various adventures? Check all the closets in the basement, first. Then read on, if you dare.
articles.author: Rebecca Corgan

articles.title: Animals Review
articles.excerpt: The new Netflix thriller Animals is tautly directed by Ben Affleck, who keeps the emphasis on the characters’ flawed humanity. None of the choices available to the protagonists are good ones, and the…
articles.body: Animals is in select theaters and on Netflix on October 9. Ben Affleck is back behind and in front of the camera with Animals, an entertaining new thriller that spices up the kidnap movie formula with a neat twist that asks big moral questions of its protagonists and viewers. Affleck plays Mark Kimball, a tycoon running as an independent candidate to become the next mayor of Los Angeles. (It should be noted that LA is currently in a heated mayoral campaign, so kudos, Netflix, on the timing of your film’s release.) Mark is a middle-aged white male Army veteran with progressive views and a Black wife and mixed-race son, who takes no outside funding and speaks fluent Spanish. It’s a cynical political strategist’s dream candidate come true, something the film acknowledges.
